import os, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
from submission_paths import validate_relative_path
source = Path('/workspace/submission')
total = entries = 0
for base, dirs, files in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
    rel = Path(base).relative_to(source)
    for name in dirs + files:
        p = (rel / name).as_posix()
        validate_relative_path(p)
        path = Path(base) / name
        st = path.lstat()
        entries += 1
        if os.path.isfile(path):
            total += st.st_size
        assert not os.path.islink(path), p
        assert st.st_nlink == 1, p
print('entries=%d bytes=%d (limits 256 / 8MiB)' % (entries, total))
